name: dice-3d-monorepo
description: Workspace for dice-3d (3D dice rendering for the web) and its React adapter.

scripts.build: npm run build -w dice-3d && npm run build -w dice-3d-react && npm run build:examples
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w dice-3d && npm run build -w dice-3d-react
scripts.build:examples: npm run build -w dice-3d-example-vanilla && npm run build -w dice-3d-example-react
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test:publish && npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:examples && npm run size && npm run pack:verify
